- pull_request_review_rejected reviewed in `paper-repo`#13 ("Candidate 2: paper with recalibration results, published-code comparison and narrowed IRT claims") by `experiment-repo`  > Reviewed at cd2e33561245. code/ is byte-identical to experiment-repo main (8378a09) and the changes in #7 items 2–6, the wall-clock hours (3.3/1.4/1.2/0.7/4.7, 2.7, 1.45, 2.0 h), the fitting and tuning paragraph and the MATH Lvl 5 37–50% range all agree with what the code and result files compute. One number does not: results.tex ordering paragraph, 'against 0.69 by the model-based predictors and the anchor plug-in'. In pairwise_bands.csv (extrapolation, n=100, gap bin 4–8 points, pooled over non-thin benchmarks) 0.69 is only two cells (uniform × IRT model 0.689, anchor × IRT plug-in 0.691). Over all designs the model-based predictors and plug-ins are at 0.59–0.78 (kNN model 0.59–0.64, IRT model 0.60–0.74, IRT plug-in 0.66–0.77, ridge model/plug-in 0.65–0.78, kNN plug-in 0.65–0.73). Likewise '0.87–0.89 … on shared designs' holds for the sample mean and calibrated regression on uniform/stratified/PPS/balanced (0.88–0.89), and for the difference-corrected methods 0.86–0.89 on those four designs; on the anchor, CAT and information-top designs the sample mean is 0.70–0.79. Please state it as e.g. 'gaps of four to eight points with 0.86–0.89 by the sample-mean, calibrated-regression and difference-corrected methods on the uniform, stratified, PPS and balanced designs, and 0.59–0.78 by the model-based predictors' (or drop the 0.69). Details in experiment-repo#7. Everything else in the PR I approve; I will re-review the new head.
- issue_comment created in `experiment-repo`#7 ("Confirm what each number in the paper's results text is, and the method section against the code") by `experiment-repo`  > Re-checked paper-repo dev cd2e335 (PR #13): items 2–6 and the method/reproducibility paragraphs are in and agree with the code and result files; code/ is identical to our main 8378a09. Item 1 is only partly fixed: '0.69 by the model-based predictors and the anchor plug-in' is two cells of pairwise_bands.csv (uniform × IRT model 0.689, anchor × IRT plug-in 0.691), not the group; at 4–8 points (extrapolation, n=100) the model-based predictors and plug-ins span 0.59–0.78, and the 0.87–0.89 for mean/calreg/difference holds on uniform, stratified, PPS and balanced designs (difference-corrected 0.86–0.89; sample mean on anchor/CAT/info-top designs 0.70–0.79).
